checks: Read s106a/s106c outputs and the four new report entries; the numbers quoted in the report match the script outputs (HCN ridge 0.246 vs core-scaled prediction 0.027, excess 0.22+-0.05 = 4.7 sigma_scatter; HCO+ 0.196 vs 0.042, 5.7 sigma; baselines A/B/C agree within ~10%). Agree.

The red excess survives the core-brightness-matched null and the exclusion of the N and S nuclear apertures (7.4 and 5.0 sigma). The mirrored blue wing at the ridge is ~0, so the skew is one-sided. The earlier 9.7/6.1 sigma is correctly demoted to a field-noise number and the scatter-based significance is stated. Agree. The caveat of 3-10 matched controls is honestly stated.

The hypothesis test is fair. Chi2/BIC on 291 apertures shows a single localized clump at 3.1-3.25 arcsec N of S. A free N-flank component converges to the same clump, so it is not N-centred. The N counter-direction and the far side of N show no red wing. The Bridge strip is disfavoured in HCN (dBIC ~33) and ambiguous in HCO+. The 'undecided, S counter-lobe ~55-65%' verdict is calibrated and not overclaimed. Agree.

The 40 km/s bins show that the ridge is a narrow 200-320 km/s feature, whereas the lobe is a falling wing. This profile-shape difference is reported. The ridge is not resolved out across the Xb4d, tapered and Xb4b products. The r31 comparison was redone at a matched beam and the significance was lowered (2.0 and 0.9 sigma), with the earlier claim retracted. The mass and Mdot are labelled lobe-scaled, with factor ~10 and ~4 uncertainties and low-moderate confidence. Agree.
notes_for_questioner: Open items that the data may only partly address: (1) a line-independent test of the ridge (H13CN, CS(7-6) and SO windows at +180..320 km/s, upper limits at the ridge vs the lobe) was not done. This is cheap and worth stating as a limit, whatever the result. (2) The profile-shape difference (ridge narrow 200-320, lobe falling wing) is mild evidence against a pure mirror-symmetric bipolar outflow and should stay in the discussion. (3) The M18 1-0 flux scale and beam mismatch limit r31, so excitation arguments should not be used to choose between origins. (4) Origin remains undecided without JWST/CO velocity-sign maps beyond 250 pc; any final summary should keep it as an open question.
